reference.status: Used by the measured playable reconstruction; not retail-disc-verified.
limitations: The conversion includes author-created rail nodes and gameplay changes; these are not original TRG rails.
Movable cereal boxes and multiplayer nodes are conversion additions; exclude them from original-level reconstruction.
Coordinates retain source units and Y-up orientation; skater scale remains to be calibrated.
Static collision vertices are already world positions. Movable objects need separate placement.
The collision/node survey contains no art; static render data and textures are extracted independently by mall-reference-art.py. No original audio or executable is included.

sharedWorkspaceNote: Validated against the frozen shared runtime. The Mall commit contains only task-owned files and the Mall material hooks in src/level.ts; concurrent movement, camera, tuning, rail and other level changes are excluded.

scale.status: Provisional visible-rider clearance fit. Both escalators and an actual escalator rail are validated; Flying Leap and original scale convention remain unverified.

checks.browser: Full-production main and four upper routes, plus lite MENU/K/L/recovery; no console errors.

fidelityRemaining: Flying Leap/gallery transfer and remaining alternate upper routes are unverified; the current probe bails on the outer gallery rail during descent.
The 0.045 scale clears the rider on the main route but final gameplay scale remains provisional.
Converted rail nodes are not retail TRG verification.
Directories and glass remain pass-through; original breakable behavior, box stacks, collectibles, sky and animated water are incomplete.

elapsed.timingNote: Continuation start uses the first recorded goal-state timestamp in this pass; original goal began in the earlier iteration.
